name: compact_feasible_completion
rationale: Collapse the correlated residual packing and cover estimates into one feasible completion estimate, merging their coefficients. Remove the overlapping residual, neighborhood and boundary edge corrections, reducing six features to two and avoiding repeated induced-edge scans and clique-cover construction. Retain the neighborhood packing penalty as a local opportunity-cost estimate. Bound and weight-scale the degree tie break so it cannot grow without limit or change priorities under uniform weight rescaling. All structural computations use the current active graph.
